_about: The GloVe k=50 tree-increment draws for P section 3, persisted because they are a RECORD and not a derivation. `k_predict_embed.py` is not reproducible to the fourth decimal and the seed does not fix it: HistGradientBoosting parallelises through OpenMP and its histogram construction is thread-order dependent, so every invocation returns a different draw. Re-running therefore cannot reproduce the booked mean of +0.0229 -- five fresh invocations give a different five and a different mean -- which is why this file TRANSCRIBES the recorded draws rather than recomputing them (registrar, [6141]). THE FIVE TRANSCRIBED DRAWS ARE NOT MEASURED HERE: they existed only as prose, in findings/P_unnamed_axis.md section 3 and in k_predict_embed.py lines 73-74, and this file is the first artifact to hold them. The sixth entry IS measured here and is kept separate from them for that reason. NOTE ON THE CITED ARTIFACT: results/k/predict_embed_en_glove.json is draw 1 of the five, the largest, and the one P explicitly forbids quoting; taking the sixth draw overwrote it, as that producer's own docstring warns any run will, and it was restored from HEAD and verified back at +0.0256. Consumed by meta/M01_displacement/scripts/plot_p_figs.py.
quantity: increment in pooled AUC over the arm's own shuffle, GloVe 300d, HistGradientBoosting trees, k=50 PCA components, English verbs
